integrity: The proof applies the source's paired-support recovery theorem to every possible \((r+1)\)-set containing the erased coordinate. A self-contained MDS support lemma proves that each such set is the exact support of a minimum dual word in both required MDS codes. A standalone finite-field verifier exhausts the source's \(q=5,n=5,d=3\) support mechanism and checks the incidence formulas.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies every recovery set of the construction's guaranteed size \(r=n-d+1\), not smaller recovery sets that an individual code might also possess. It concerns one erased transmitted qudit at a time under the source model with Bob's entanglement register reliable.
title: Universal helper-set recovery in the MDS-pair EAQLRC family
